body.text: NUP is the uninterruptible AC system, and NDC is the DC system. Both power NI systems in all modes.
body.anchor: The NDC and NUP provide power to NI systems and components during all modes of plant operation

body.text: Failures of the NUP or NDC do not affect the plant's ability to perform SR functions.
body.anchor: Failures of the NUP or NDC do not affect the ability of the plant to perform safety-related (SR) functions

body.text: Portions in Divisions A, B, C, and D are NSRST, because they power NSRST SSC functions.
body.anchor: Certain portions of the NUP and NDC (comprising Divisions A, B, C, and D) are classified as NSRST

body.text: Electrical systems are otherwise NST.
body.anchor: These systems are classified as non-safety-related with no special treatment (NST)

body.text: The NUP has four independent divisions, one per RPS division.
body.anchor: the NUP comprises four independent divisions (A, B, C, and D)

items: 120 VAC single-phase inverter with integrated static transfer switch (STS)
Two 120 VAC panelboards, one UPS-backed and one not
body.anchor: Each division includes a 120 VAC single-phase inverter

body.text: In normal operation, the inverter takes 250 VDC from its switchboard and makes regulated 120 VAC for the UPS panelboard.
body.anchor: each inverter receives 250 VDC from the respective division 250 VDC switchboard

body.text: The non-UPS panelboard feeds the same loads as a backup.
body.anchor: The non-UPS-backed panelboard feeds the same loads as the UPS-backed panelboard as a backup

body.text: Each RVT takes 480 VAC from the same NST SDG-backed MCC as that division's normal battery charger.
body.anchor: Each division RVT receives 480 VAC power

body.text: The NDC has four independent 250 VDC divisions, one per RPS division.
body.anchor: the NDC comprises four independent 250 VDC divisions

body.text: Each division has a battery bank, a Battery Transfer Switch (BTS), a normal switchboard, and access to two chargers.
body.anchor: Each division has one battery bank, a Battery Transfer Switch (BTS), one normal switchboard

body.text: Each charger can supply its loads while recharging its battery from design minimum to full within 24 hours.
body.anchor: to full charge within 24 hours

body.text: Swing chargers are shared between Divisions A and B, and between C and D.
body.anchor: The swing chargers are shared between Divisions A and B DC switchboards

rows.anchor: Divisions A and B batteries are sized to supply the respective division loads for 72 hours
Divisions C and D batteries are sized to supply the respective division loads for 2 hours

body.text: Batteries are sealed Valve-Regulated Lead-Acid.
body.anchor: The batteries are sealed Valve-Regulated Lead-Acid type

body.cap: Simplified NSRST Electrical Systems Single Line Diagram - Divisions C and D
body.alt: PSAR Rev 1 figure: Simplified NSRST Electrical Systems Single Line Diagram - Divisions C and D

checks.q: How long are Division A and B batteries sized for?
checks.x: Divisions A and B are sized for 72 hours.
checks.anchor: Divisions A and B batteries are sized to supply the respective division loads for 72 hours

checks.q: How long are Division C and D batteries sized for?
checks.x: Divisions C and D are sized for 2 hours.
checks.anchor: Divisions C and D batteries are sized to supply the respective division loads for 2 hours

checks.q: Which divisions share a swing charger?
checks.x: Swing chargers are shared between A and B, and between C and D.
checks.anchor: The swing chargers are shared between Divisions A and B DC switchboards

checks.q: What is the NDC battery type?
checks.anchor: The batteries are sealed Valve-Regulated Lead-Acid type

body.text: If an inverter fails or there is an output overload or short, the STS automatically transfers UPS loads to the RVT.
body.anchor: the inverter’s STS initiates an automatic transfer of the AC UPS loads to the RVT

body.text: For inverter maintenance, loads go to the RVT using the RMBS.
body.anchor: the loads can be transferred to the RVT using the RMBS

body.text: On loss of offsite power, NST SDGs start automatically and power their MCCs.
body.anchor: are automatically started to power their associated MCCs

body.text: Batteries supply uninterrupted power until the SDGs come online.
body.anchor: The batteries supply uninterrupted power to the inverters and UPS panelboard loads until the SDGs come online

body.text: Loss of one NLV MCC loses one charger until the swing charger is on line, and the battery carries the loads.
body.anchor: The loss of one NLV MCC results in a loss of function of one charger until the swing charger is brought on line

body.text: If input voltage and frequency are out of limits, chargers shut down and isolate the NDC, then return automatically.
body.anchor: The battery chargers return to operation automatically

body.text: Charger DC overvoltage protection shuts the charger down before inverter overvoltage protection acts.
body.anchor: shuts down the charger automatically before the inverter overvoltage protection is activated

body.text: The NDC is ungrounded. Ground detection relays send a common trouble alarm to the UMC.
body.anchor: The NDC is ungrounded

checks.q: An inverter fails. What happens to the UPS panelboard?
o: An operator must close the RMBS
The STS automatically transfers it to the RVT
checks.x: The STS automatically transfers the UPS loads to the RVT.
checks.anchor: the inverter’s STS initiates an automatic transfer of the AC UPS loads to the RVT

checks.q: How is an inverter taken out for maintenance?
checks.x: Loads are transferred to the RVT using the RMBS.
checks.anchor: the loads can be transferred to the RVT using the RMBS

checks.q: An NLV MCC is lost. What carries the division until the swing charger is on line?
checks.x: The battery supplies power until the swing charger is operating.
checks.anchor: The battery supplies uninterruptible power to the system loads until the swing charger is operating

checks.x: The NDC is ungrounded, with ground detection relays.

body.text: Voltmeters and ammeters give continuous monitoring locally and through the UMC.
body.anchor: to provide continuous monitoring locally in the equipment rooms and remotely via the UMC

body.text: The BTS allows battery equalization and discharge testing.

body.text: NUP and NDC support NSRST functions, including scram follow, seismic trip, pump trips, and PAM.
body.anchor: DL4-RC3 Control Rod Drive Driveline Scram Follow

body.text: Safety-significant components are in the NCB substructure.
body.anchor: are located within, and protected by, the reinforced concrete Nuclear Island Control Building (NCB) substructure

title: Nuclear Island Auxiliary Electrical Systems
subject: NUP and NDC
intro: The NUP and NDC give the Nuclear Island uninterruptible AC and DC power. They are not safety related. The safety functions do not depend on them, which is a key design point.
